title: UI风格#155 - Steampunk Minimal (蒸汽朋克极简)
description: 创建第155种UI风格：蒸汽朋克极简风格 - 简化版蒸汽朋克、齿轮与蒸汽。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planEY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Minimal style When color palette Then features brass gold, copper bronze, steam white, dark brown
Given Steampunk Minimal style When typography Then uses industrial: Oswald, Roboto Mono, or Share Tech Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Oswald (headers 2.2rem 600 weight), Roboto Mono (body 0.9rem) - industrial Victorian typography

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Minimal style When layout Then minimal gears, clean pipes, simple gauges, brass accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: brass/gold borders, gear decorations (⚙), steam-powered aesthetic, industrial layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Minimal style When UI elements Then gear animations, brass textures, steam wisps
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: gear icons, brass gradient accents, copper/bronze borders, steam-white text on dark background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Minimal UI When functional Then includes engine chat, inventor agents, pressure stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Engine chat with ONLINE status, 4 inventor agents (TESLA COIL, GEARWRIGHT, COPPERFIELD, WATT'SON) with Power/Voltage/Steam/Pressure/Boiler/Temp/Efficiency/Fuel stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Minimal UI When copy Then uses Victorian industrial: 'Engine', 'Pressure', 'Steam', 'Gear'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'ENGINE. PRESSURE. GEAR.', tagline '// STEAM_POWERED //', button 'IGNITE', greeting 'THE ENGINE RUNS HOT. WHAT SHALL WE CONSTRUCT TODAY...', status 'ACTIVE'/'IDLE', nav 'Engine'/'Ignite'/'Engage'/'Steam'
